cv_data.headline: BUSINESS ANALYTICS & REPORTING CONSULTANT
cv_data.summary: Dedicated Business Analytics Consultant skilled in designing scalable data pipelines, developing impactful BI solutions, and optimizing SQL queries to deliver high-quality, accessible reporting. Proactive in identifying trends, streamlining data engineering workflows, and translating complex datasets into actionable insights. Strong focus on client and stakeholder collaboration, technical training, and clear communication. Thrives in dynamic consulting environments, always looking for ways to improve, adapt, and deliver meaningful value through data.

roles.title: Business Analytics Consultant
bullets: Multi-Industry BI & Insights: Delivered end-to-end Power BI reporting, dbt data modeling, and actionable insights for major enterprise clients across broadcasting & media, national gaming & lotteries, and manufacturing sectors.

Enterprise Data Governance: Architected and executed a large-scale Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) security framework in Snowflake, deploying complex permission scripts with zero errors on initial rollout to secure client data.

dbt & CI/CD Pipeline Optimization: Built and optimized client dbt and Coalesce data transformation environments in Snowflake, standardizing modular models, automated data quality tests, and CI/CD deployments.

Marketing Pipelines & Enablement: Engineered automated analytical pipelines integrating Google Ad Manager data and designed a "Fundamentals of Coalesce" training curriculum to upskill external clients.

roles.title: Reporting & Insights Analyst
bullets: Internal Promotion & Leadership: Promoted from Analytics Engineer to Reporting & Insights Analyst in recognition of strong stakeholder engagement, impactful reporting solutions, and driving data accessibility.
Cloud Analytics Engineering: Engineered Power BI solutions with Databricks and Apache Spark to uncover customer-management and operational insights, directly empowering strategic business decisions.
Embedded Portal Analytics: Developed and embedded Power BI dashboards within the Salesforce Customer Portal, significantly improving stakeholder access to insights and accelerating decision-making.
Cloud Migration & Adoption: Led cross-functional workshops and training during a major cloud migration, driving adoption of new Power BI reports and championing data as a product across the business.

roles.title: Analytics Engineer
bullets: Workflow Automation: Developed Power BI dashboards and Power Apps solutions to automate reporting workflows, eliminating 24 hours of manual processing each month.
Self-Service Data Modeling: Designed and launched curated dimensional data models, empowering business users with self-service analytics and reducing reliance on ad-hoc report requests.

Cost & Data Quality Optimization: Led multi-source logistics analysis assessing data completeness, forecasting accuracy, and timeliness, driving direct-from-carrier integrations at significantly lower cost.

roles.title: Data and Reporting Analyst
bullets: Data Warehouse Modernization: Led the adoption of Power BI for a large-scale data warehousing project, utilizing SQL for data cleansing, migration, and analysis to transition legacy reports into modern dashboards.

cv_data.headline: SENIOR 3D CAD/CAM DESIGNER & CNC MANUFACTURING LEAD
cv_data.summary: Hands-on 3D CAD/CAM Specialist and CNC Workshop Manager with deep expertise bridging complex 3D surface modelling and precision digital fabrication. Proven track record of translating architectural artist concepts into production-ready 3D building facade geometry, engineering high-performance yachting components for America's Cup campaigns, and leading end-to-end marine CNC machining operations. Experienced in managing distributed international design workflows, including leading remote CAD/CAM direct reports in Europe while running local workshop production in New Zealand.

roles.title: CNC Workshop Manager & Lead 3D CAD/CAM Technician
bullets: End-to-End 3D Design to Fabrication: Lead both 3D CAD modelling and multi-axis CAM toolpath programming through to hands-on CNC machine operation for precision marine engineering and bespoke structural components.

International Remote Team Leadership: Manage and review daily CAD/CAM deliverables for a direct report working remotely from Poland, coordinating asynchronous 3D file handoffs, quality control, and production scheduling.
Workshop Operations & Optimization: Oversee machine scheduling, tooling selection, material nesting, and quality assurance to hit tight marine refit and custom manufacturing deadlines.
Design for Manufacturability (DFM): Partner directly with naval architects, engineers, and project managers to refine 3D geometries for optimal CNC machining efficiency and structural tolerance.

roles.title: Senior 3D CAD & Facade Modeller
bullets: Concept-to-CAD Facade Engineering: Translated 2D artist impressions and architectural concept sketches into millimeter-accurate 3D models for complex commercial building facades and bespoke architectural elements.
Fabrication-Ready Geometry: Developed parametric and complex surface models engineered specifically for downstream CNC milling, mould-making, and structural assembly.
Multi-Disciplinary Coordination: Collaborated with architects, structural engineers, and fabrication teams to resolve geometric clashes and deliver complete 3D production packages.

experience.company: Emirates Team New Zealand (America's Cup Campaign Contractors)

roles.title: 3D CAD Modeller & High-Performance Marine Component Specialist
bullets: America's Cup 3D Part Modelling: Created precision 3D CAD models for custom high-performance yachting parts, aerodynamic/hydrodynamic tooling, and composite mould assemblies for New Zealand's America's Cup team.
Ultra-Tight Tolerance Execution: Delivered complex 3D surface and solid models under high-pressure campaign timelines where weight, strength, and sub-millimeter CNC accuracy were mission-critical.

cv_data.technology: 3D CAD Surface & Solid Modelling (Rhino 3D, Grasshopper, SolidWorks, Fusion 360, AutoCAD, Inventor), CAM Toolpath Programming (Mastercam, PowerMill, Fusion CAM), Multi-Axis CNC Routing & Milling, G-Code, DFM, PDM/Cloud CAD Collaboration.

cv_data.headline: 3D MODELLER & DIGITAL FABRICATION SPECIALIST
cv_data.summary: Precision-focused 3D Modeller and Digital Fabrication Specialist with extensive experience generating production-ready models for CNC machining and industrial fabrication. Adept at transforming technical concepts and 2D blueprints into highly accurate 3D CAD assets optimized for multi-axis tooling, subtractive manufacturing, and tight tolerance specs. Collaborates seamlessly with engineers, machinists, and project managers to streamline production workflows and cut material waste.

roles.title: 3D Modeller & CNC Specialist
bullets: Precision CAD Construction: Developed high-precision 3D surface and solid models tailored specifically for multi-axis CNC routers and automated fabrication equipment.
Design for Manufacturability: Optimized complex model geometries and material allowances to ensure zero-defect CNC output and reduced machining cycle times.
Technical Workflow Integration: Translated raw conceptual sketches and client specifications into standardized digital assets ready for CAM programming and physical production.
Quality Control Standards: Applied tight dimensioning and tolerancing techniques to deliver components that consistently met strict fit-and-finish specifications.
